digest.component_or_area: AST provenance indexing in subcall class selection tests
propositions: The session-scoped provenance fixture rebuilds parent maps and rescans source trees millions of times during test setup, causing 46-49s overhead in Ubuntu CI.
Parsed AST trees are cached but parent-child and caller-site relationships are recomputed on every lookup via repeated ast.walk traversals.
An immutable per-process index of parent, enclosing function, and call-site relationships built once from cached trees eliminates redundant whole-tree rediscovery.
The deterministic oracle validates that the 24 ordered provenance tuples and all existing guard verdicts remain exactly unchanged after indexing.
Cold-process setup time improved from 3.26s to 0.81s (~4x) and AST iterations reduced from 9.6M to 0.57M with index-based querying.
